memory_candidates.content: When retargeting a shell-suite assertion to negate an invocation line (e.g. 'no /merge line should appear'), reuse the anchored negative regex shape '^  ?/merge( |$)' (match a 2-or-fewer-space-indented invocation line, not prose mentioning the command) already proven in test-milestone-review-handoff.sh Case 3, rather than inventing a bare substring negation that would also pass for the wrong reason (e.g. if the whole producing call stopped firing).

verify-touched.sh / run-all.sh's default exit-code semantics are 'exit 1 if any suite failed, EXPECTED or not' (--fail-on-new is required to exit 0 on an all-expected failure set). When a batch-deferred scoped gate discharge exits 1, check the tally's own '(N expected, M NEW)' clause and known-failures.txt before treating it as a regression: an exit 1 with 0 NEW and the sole failure listed in known-failures.txt is a satisfied discharge, not a blocker, and should be recorded via issue-record.sh rather than re-run or escalated.

sapience_notes.subject: run-all.sh default exit-code semantics
sapience_notes.value: Without --fail-on-new, run-all.sh exits 1 on any failed suite, expected or not; only --fail-on-new restricts the nonzero exit to NEW failures. verify-touched.sh does not pass --fail-on-new, so a scoped discharge can exit 1 purely from a pre-existing, already-catalogued known-failure with zero new regressions.

sapience_notes.subject: Harness auto-backgrounding of a piped Bash call
sapience_notes.value: A foreground Bash call piped into `tail` (e.g. `cmd | tail -60`) that exceeds the tool's inner timeout gets auto-backgrounded by the harness, but the captured output file stays empty until the ENTIRE pipeline (including the downstream tail) finishes, because the pipe buffers. Polling that output file mid-run is useless; the only reliable mid-run signal is checking the underlying process's liveness directly (e.g. via /proc cmdline matching) when no PID was captured ahead of time.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh OWED-fallback for an unmappable scope entry
sapience_notes.value: Declaring a non-real path like __WHOLE_TREE__ in a plan phase's Files to modify causes verify-touched.sh to run a second, broader run-all.sh pass (the OWED fallback set, --cost-class free) in addition to the narrowed root-level suite run for the real touched paths -- both passes run, and a failure in either contributes to the overall nonzero exit.
